question: How do donor-level captured macrophage annotations, prespecified human transcript panels and same-donor epithelial/fibroblast context vary across Control, IPF and COPD and within each disease?
decision: Describe which observed panel differences and within-disease associations persist across prespecified annotation/coverage sensitivities, without validating NAM identity or a causal/functional mechanism.
strongest_rival: Disease, capture depth, macrophage/recipient composition, inherited RNA annotations and unmeasured clinical covariates explain pooled associations; same-source panels are not independent evidence.
discriminator: Primary deposited Macrophage at20cells; all-macrophage, alveolar and source-five-marker detection proxies as sensitivities. Report all donor contrasts, within-disease versus pooled covariance and Fibroblast-only recipient sensitivity with support/constant-variable holds.
exposure_record: Exposed atlas papers, prior Ravel GSE136831 results, metadata/donor coverage and source labels. Public primary Apte and Liu panel definitions and reviewer-inspected DY1 human figure markers were read before freeze. No new expression contrast was inspected before this numerical specification; this is not confirmatory.
biological_unit: 78 source-defined human donors;107 deposited libraries and cells nested within donors. No library or cell is treated as an independent human replicate.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated libraries are summed within each Subject_Identity. Same donors/source reused throughout Ravel and the Apte panel selection remain one evidence lineage, not independent replication. No anatomical NAM or recipient lineage identity is inferred.
population_and_selection: All312928 deposited cells from28Control,32IPF,18COPD donors; Multiplet label excluded from analytical denominators but retained in audits. Exact source annotation/category sets and30native human gene IDs are bound in human_panels_v1.json. Primary Macrophage population and20cell floor fixed before outcomes;10/50cell and proxy1/2/3 sensitivities retained.
contrast: IPF-Control, COPD-Control and IPF-COPD donor contrasts. Within-disease and diagnostic pooled panel coupling and macrophage-to-recipient RNA/composition associations. ARG1 distribution only among captured annotations.
endpoint: Donor captured-cell fractions; gene and panel mean-log2(all-gene CPM+1); ARG1 detection fractions; disease mean differences; Spearman and composition/depth-sensitive partial rank correlations. No activity, secretion, flux, human training or causal mediation endpoint.
methods: One chunked integer-matrix pass retains exact declared native-human genes and all-gene cell totals. Check nUMI/nGene parity, barcode order and positive integer/dimension/entry-count validity. Aggregate donor-by-population. Bootstrap donor mean differences2000times (>=3donors/group) and paired-donor Spearman1000times (>=8varying donors); seed20261029. Withhold correlation CI if <95%valid resamples and mean-difference CI if bootstrap distribution constant; record replicate counts. Partial ranks use log1p(totalcaptured),meanUMI,macrophage fraction and pooled disease indicators only at full rank and residualdf>=6. Fibroblast-only recipients and composition shares supplement unions. Exact comparison rules are in the bound code and prospective plan.
missingness_and_exclusions: No outcome-dependent exclusion. Missing or ambiguous native symbols hold affected analysis; all30symbols are unique before freeze. Zero abundance numerator retained; absent denominator missing. All below-floor values retained. Sparse/constant comparisons and missing clinical covariates explicit. Neutrophils are not annotated; no tissue-wide ARG1 attribution.
multiplicity: No p-values or significance labels. All predefined comparisons and sensitivities retained; bootstrap95%intervals are pointwise descriptive, not simultaneous or multiplicity-controlled claims.
precision_basis: Cell floors are eligibility diagnostics, not power. Donors resampled as units; percentile intervals do not address unmeasured confounding, atlas selection or ascertainment. Sparse/undefined resamples reported, not rescued.
interpretation_limit: Observed human atlas RNA/annotation descriptions only. A five-marker proxy is not a validated NAM identity or exact author-cluster reproduction. Pooled disease separation is not within-disease coupling. Captured cells cannot establish tissue-wide ARG1 dominance, spatial signaling, mature repair, protein output, activity or causal effects; A1/A22 remain contextual links.
stop_rule: Stop and retain receipts on hash/identity/count-semantic/independent-arithmetic disagreement. No marker or floor adjustment after outcomes, restricted mouse/infection work, governance change or biological engineering. Retain nulls and explicit unsupported comparisons.
amendment_reason: Separate prospective numerical human observational stage after donor qualification; primary source-label description and explicit marker-proxy adaptations replace unsupported exact NAM-reproduction wording without resuming restricted analyses.
